test_name: Verify Navigation to API Reference Page
description: This test ensures that users can successfully navigate to the API Reference page from the login screen.
steps: Assert that the page title is 'Roost Enterprise Login | Software as a Service'.
Scroll down to the footer of the page.
Locate the 'API Reference' link using its stable selector.
Verify that the browser navigates to the API Reference page.
Assert that the API Reference page title includes 'API Reference'.
Verify that the API documentation content is visible on the page.
expected_results: The user is navigated to the API Reference page.
The API documentation content is displayed.
edge_cases: The API Reference page link is broken.
The API Reference page takes too long to load.
The link is not visible due to a CSS issue.
The user clicks the link but the page navigation does not occur.
JavaScript is disabled, and the link fails to work.
data_requirements: A valid link to the API Reference page.
API documentation accessible on the target page.
Correct URL configuration for the 'API Reference' link.
dependencies: The API Reference page must be published and accessible.
The 'API Reference' link must be configured correctly.
The footer must be visible on the login page.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the API Reference page.
accessibility_requirements: The 'API Reference' link must be accessible via keyboard navigation.
The link must have appropriate ARIA labels.
Screen reader compatibility must be verified for the link.
